caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a brown sculpture of a squirrel sitting upright on its haunches atop an oval-shaped base with a dotted border. The squirrel is rendered in various shades of brown and appears to be holding a small round object, possibly a nut, in its front paws close to its mouth. Its bushy tail curves upward and backward. The background of the drawing is an unadorned, light beige color with no additional elements or details, creating a stark contrast that highlights the central figure. The artist's signature is faintly visible in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Squirrel Statuette
